title: Send-ref exclusion predicate also excludes genuine email-only invites — AD-7 exhaustion is dead for phone-less referees
evidence:
+    AND NOT (
+      e ? 'kind'
+      OR (e->>'channel' = 'email'
+          AND NOT EXISTS (
+            SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(rc.attempts) AS s
+            WHERE s->>'at' = e->>'at' AND s->>'channel' = 'sms'
+          ))
+    )
...
+    OR (rc.correction_cycles = 0 AND $1 <> ''
+        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(rc.corrected_email, ''), rc.contact_email) = $1)
+    OR (rc.correction_cycles = 0 AND $2 <> ''
+        AND COALESCE(NULLIF(rc.corrected_phone, ''), rc.contact_phone) = $2)
detail: The match excludes every email entry without a same-timestamp sms, so genuine email-only sends (phone-less referees, or a cleared post-correction channel) never match a bounce; the fallback is disabled once correction_cycles >= 1, so the second failure never exhausts — no unreachable terminal, no referee_contact_invalid stamp.
recommended_fix: Match email-only delivered entries too (exclude only kind-tagged co-nudges), or keep the exclusion and add a correction_cycles >= 1 email fallback so corrected phone-less rows still exhaust.

title: Substitute compares use corrected ?? snapshot unconditionally — the W4 corrected-only rule is missed at the sibling site
detail: Both substitute compares ignore correction_cycles, but W4 says post-correction the snapshot is proven dead. On exhausted rows the dead snapshot still counts: SameReferee false-400s, and the successor no-op detector silently accepts a dead-contact re-submit — the exact r4 N7 failure the comment claims to close.
recommended_fix: Gate both compares on correction_cycles >= 1 (corrected-only), mirroring form_handler's effective(); a cleared channel compares as absent, never against the proven-dead snapshot.

title: find_reference_call_by_send_ref reordered its TEXT params — a stale caller compiles and silently mis-matches every bounce
evidence:
---- find_reference_call_by_send_ref(send_ref_json: TEXT, contact_email: TEXT, contact_phone: TEXT)
+--- find_reference_call_by_send_ref(contact_email: TEXT, contact_phone: TEXT, send_ref: TEXT)
detail: The send_ref moved from $1 to $3; all three args are TEXT, so any un-updated caller in webhooks.gleam compiles cleanly while matching the send id against the email column — every delivery-failure event silently stands down.
recommended_fix: Verify webhooks.gleam's call site passes (contact_email, contact_phone, send_ref) in the new order, and pin the contract with an integration test bouncing a real provider id.

title: verify_application_in_vacancy DB errors fall into the 404 arm — transient failures surface as 'Application not found'
evidence:
+  case
+    sql.verify_application_in_vacancy(db, app_uuid, vacancy_uuid, landlord_uuid)
+  {
+    Ok(pog.Returned(_, [row])) if row.match_count > 0 ->
...
+    _ ->
+      response_helpers.json_error(
+        error_code.NotFound,
+        "Application not found",
+        404,
+      )
+  }
detail: An Error(err) from the precheck falls through the match guard into the 404 arm: a database outage is reported as not-found with no log line and no 500. Safe (no mutation) but mislabeled and unobservable.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit Error(err) arm that logs and returns the shared db_failure 500, leaving 404 for genuine zero-match results only.

title: Idempotent substitute no-op returns the same success shape as a real substitution — client toasts a fresh invite that never went out
evidence:
+    // True idempotent no-op (the successor already carries this trio).
+    Ok(Existing(new_id)) ->
+      json_ok(
+        json.object([
+          #("substituted", json.bool(True)),
+          #("reference_call_id", json.string(new_id)),
+        ]),
+      )
detail: The no-op path (re-submit of the history row with the successor's trio) returns 200 {'substituted': true}, indistinguishable from a real insert — the client toasts 'Referee substituted - the new invitation is on its way.' though nothing was sent.
recommended_fix: Return a distinct marker for the Existing path (e.g. 'already_substituted') and have the client toast accordingly, or suppress the affordance on rows whose slot already has a live successor.
